name: a click changes the screen and Escape puts it back, pixel for pixel
why: The smoke test for the whole scaffold, written so that it fails when any link lies. If the click
never reached the window server the second frame equals the first; if the merge of overlays or
the escape decode were wrong the two hashes would not come back equal; if Accessibility were
blind the menu assertion still passes, which is exactly why the picture is the assertion here.
The capture is cropped to y>=30 so the menu-bar clock cannot make an unchanged screen look
changed — a flaky smoke test is worse than none.
notes: Finder is raised first: opening the Apple menu also raises the frontmost app's window, and that
legitimate raise would make a correct close look like a changed screen.
